description: dataset.gov.md: telecommunications datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Government Open Data Portal Moldova, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by dataset.gov.md. Coverage: the area served by dataset.gov.md. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about telecommunications; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Evoluţia pieţelor de Comunicaţii Electronice; Registrul public al furnizorilor de reţele şi servicii de comunicaţii ; Dezvoltarea serviciilor în bandă largă la puncte fixe în unităţile adm; Gradul de acoperire cu cadre didactice. Formats seen: XLSX, XLS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is License Not Specified. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-government-open-data-portal-moldova.
